comment.body: This will crash when items is empty — please guard it.
Why a Map here instead of an object?
The SQL here is built by string concatenation from user input — this is an injection risk, must be parameterised.
Is there a reason we poll every 4s rather than subscribe to events?
Optional: could use optional chaining here for brevity.
This deletes the user's worktree without checking for unpushed commits. Blocking.
Does this still work when the Keychain is locked?
tiny style thing: trailing whitespace on line 40
Agreed with the approach, let's do the follow-up in a separate PR.
